notes.title: Thanks for the 100+ wishlists
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914214/ac81b094f34ea18239d617eeaf820223feb678d9.png[/img]

I want to thank you so much for the support you are giving us. I never imagined we would have so many [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2849050/Anomaly_Echoes/]wishlists[/url] in our first game.

Thank you very much for giving this vote of confidence in us. We hope you really like what we have prepared for you.

If you didn't know, now you will know my noble (lol)... Join the Anomaly Echoes [url=https://discord.gg/cPEP2GKCy8]discord[/url]. There you can chat with us to find out more about the game.

Get there, we'll be waiting for you... I'll see you there (at [url=https://discord.gg/cPEP2GKCy8]discord[/url]) and may God bless you!
